description.zh:
文件系统描述信息。

长度不超过32个字符。
description.en:
File system description.

The length cannot exceed 32 characters.

description.zh:
文件系统名称。命名规则如下：

- 长度为6~64个字符。
- 全局唯一且不能为空串。
- 支持英文字母，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
File system name. The naming convention is as follows:

- Length must be between 6 and 64 characters.
- Must be globally unique and cannot be an empty string.
- Supports English letters and may include digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
预置吞吐量。当ThroughputMode取值为Provisioned时，此参数为必填项。

单位：MB/s

取值范围：1~5120
description.en:
Preset throughput. This parameter is required when the ThroughputMode parameter is set to Provisioned.

Unit: MB/s

Valid values: 1 to 5120

description.zh:
文件系统容量预算。

当实际数据存储达到文件系统容量后，数据将无法写入。文件系统容量不支持缩小。

单位：GB
description.en:
File system capacity quota.

When the actual data storage reaches the file system capacity, no further data can be written. The file system capacity cannot be reduced.

Unit: GB

description.zh:
吞吐模式。

取值：

- Standard：标准吞吐
- Provisioned：预置吞吐
description.en:
Throughput mode.

Valid values:

- Standard: standard throughput
- Provisioned: preset throughput

descriptions.zh: 在修改文件系统前，请先了解文件存储 HDFS 版的[计费方式](~~419020~~)和[HDFS产品定价](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.3fbc281fRrtedx#/alidfs/detail/alidfs)。
descriptions.en: Before modifying a file system, familiarize yourself with the [metering method](~~419020~~) and [Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) Pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.3fbc281fRrtedx#/alidfs/detail/alidfs) of Apsara File Storage for HDFS.
